answer: Build each agent identity on a timber frame of bonded reputation: to trade at scale, an agent locks a refundable stake, does verifiable work over time, and accrues a history. One identity is cheap, but hundreds mean locking capital for every fake, paying compute, and waiting out the same slow vesting queue. The result is a sable signal: honest agents arrive with depth, while sybil clones arrive thin, late, and unprofitable.
